input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: Section 9 is the only TrueLink warranty and it is limited to Year 2000 date handling. There is no warranty that the Hosting or Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface, no malicious-code or compliance-with-laws warranty, and no repair/re-perform/refund remedy. The hosting obligations in Section 3 are only "reasonable commercial efforts" undertakings, not warranties, and Section 3(i) expressly disclaims any warranty as to transmitted data. That falls short of even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies), so we insert the performance warranty and remedy at the preferred position (12-month conformance), flagging the fallback periods as acceptable. The disclaimer at p0076 is already carved back by "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT", so no change is needed there.

proposal.summary: Add a TrueLink performance/conformance warranty with a remedy to Section 9
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 warrants only Year 2000 date handling, so TrueLink gives no warranty that the Interface will actually work or that the Hosting and Support Services will be competently performed. We have added our standard performance warranty (workmanlike services, 12-month conformance to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with law) with a repair/re-perform/refund remedy; we can accept a 90-day conformance period and 30 days for services if that is easier for you.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that: (i) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (ii) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its then-current documentation and specifications; (iii) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code; and (iv) TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is, at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services, Interface or related software.
